title: Yummy Venezuelan Pork Stew
description: A sour, tender stew with thyme and nuka-pickle that satisfies midnight cravings while staying keto-friendly.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the pork shoulder pieces and sear on all sides until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork and set aside, then sauté the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and tomato until softened, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the thyme, nuka-pickle brine, and a pinch of salt and pepper, letting the aromatics bloom for 2 minutes.
Return the pork to the pot, pour in the chicken stock, and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the pork is fall-through-the-hand tender.
Stir in the chopped cilantro, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with extra cilantro, and enjoy the sour, midnight-craving flavor.
